segments.name: config
segments.comment: Configuration register where the NCC mode will be stored.

segments.name: port
segments.comment: Configure the base event for the timing pattern of either the NCC operation (0) or the reset operation (1).

segments.name: port
segments.comment: Configure the repetition operator to target either the NCC operation (0) or the reset operation (1).

segments.name: step
segments.comment: Step size between the addresses generated for each iteration. On the NCC port, the address selects a configured NCC mode.

segments.name: port
segments.comment: Configure the repetition extension to target either the NCC operation (0) or the reset operation (1).

segments.name: iter
segments.comment: Most significant bits to apply to the `iter` value of the repetition operator.

segments.name: step
segments.comment: Most significant bits to apply to the `step` value of the repetition operator.

segments.name: delay
segments.comment: Most significant bits to apply to the `delay` value of the repetition operator.

segments.comment: Configure the transition operator to target either the NCC operation (0) or the reset operation (1).
